title: One-coordinate support estimate over a strictly localized trait model
statement:
Let $C$ be a complete discrete valuation ring, meaning a Noetherian local domain of dimension one with principal maximal ideal and complete for its powers [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let $B$ be a scheme of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}C$, let $\bar t$ be a geometric point of $B$, and put $T=B_{(\bar t)}$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Write $\delta_T(t)=\dim\overline{\{t\}}$, with closure taken in $T$ [def-per-geometric-dimension-function]. For $j\geq0$ put $P_j=\mathbf A^j_T$, with structure map $a_j:P_j\to T$, and put
$$\delta_j(z)=\delta_T(a_j(z))+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(a_j(z))}\kappa(z)$$
[def-sbc-affine-space, def-weil-residue-field, def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible on $T$ and an integer $m\geq0$. Let $p_m:P_{m+1}\to P_m$ forget the last coordinate. For a constructible sheaf $M$ of $\mathbf F_\ell$-modules on the ordinary small etale site of $P_{m+1}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], let $R^rp_{m*}M$ be the higher direct image, formed on the underlying abelian etale sheaf with its induced $\mathbf F_\ell$-action [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. If $b\in\mathbf Z$ satisfies $\delta_{m+1}(z)\leq b$ whenever $M_{\bar z}\neq0$, then, for every $r\geq0$ and every geometric point $\bar v$ of $P_m$,
$$(R^rp_{m*}M)_{\bar v}\neq0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\delta_m(v)\leq b-r,$$
where $v$ is the underlying point and stalks are those of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].

source.place: Expose XV Theorem 1.1.2, restricted to the affine-line projection, and Remark 1.1.3 (finite-type-over-a-trait case); strict-local passage and normalized dimension functions in XV 1.2.1 and 3.3.2. Original trait theorem: Illusie, Perversite et variation (2003), Theorem 2.4, WANTED.
